description: Read both oppositely hatched rectangles as displacement magnitudes s = vt and s_1 = |v_1|t. Preserve their shared velocity/time frame, unequal right extents and original subscript/sign. Coordinates are normalized layout units, not source numerical data.

authoritativeText.text:
在利用运动图线的同时，往往还利用速度图线.
取纵轴表示物体速度的投影，而横轴仍按以前规定表示时间，则可以得到速度图线.
这种图线表示速度如何随时间变化，即速度和时间的关系.

在匀速直线运动的情况下，这个“依赖关系”是：速度不随时间改变.
因此，速度图线是平行于时间轴的直线（图 30）.
图 30 上的图线 $\mathrm{I}$ 是属于物体向 $X$ 轴正方向运动的情况.

图线 $\mathrm{II}$ 是属于向相反方向运动的情况（速度的投影为负值）.

根据速度图线，也可以知道物体在给定时间间隔内位移的绝对值.
它的数值等于画细线的长方形面积（图 31）：如果物体向正方向运动，则为上面的长方形面积；
在相反情况下，为下面的长方形面积.

实际上，长方形的面积等于它的两个邻边的乘积.
但是，以一定比例的一个边等于时间 $t$，而另一个边等于速度 $v$.
它们的乘积 $vt$ 恰好等于物体位移的绝对值.

inventory.description: One velocity/time frame: upward v arrow, rightward t arrow, negative vertical extension, short left extension, digit 0 at the shared origin; no ticks or units.
Upper rectangle shares origin and both axes; positive velocity v, printed s = vt; four straight boundaries remain unfilled, all corners and adjacent dimensions executable.

Lower rectangle shares origin and both axes; negative level printed v_1 without a leading minus, formula s_1 = |v_1|t retains magnitude bars and subscript ones; all four corners and dimensions executable.

Lower right boundary is left of upper right boundary; lower depth slightly exceeds upper height. t is the source time-axis symbol, not a common endpoint tick. Coordinates are normalized, nonphysical drawing units.

Source upper opposite-slope hatching, with normalized spacing and enlarged formula-only clearance to accommodate actual glyph bounds plus endpoint safety clearance. Full rectangle boundaries unchanged.

Source lower opposite-slope hatching, with normalized spacing and enlarged formula-only clearance to accommodate actual glyph bounds plus endpoint safety clearance. Full rectangle boundaries unchanged.
